title: Digital Health Solutions Service Engineer
desc:
With a passion for life
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
Key Qualifications
Graduated from relevant departments of vocational schools.
3 years of experience in digital solutions in the healthcare industry.
Experienced in wiring, connection, and working with low current.
Knowledge of programming languages, SQL knowledge is preferred
Advanced proficiency in English.
Strong analytical mindset with a proactive, results-oriented, and quality-driven approach.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Valid B-class driving license and willingness to travel frequently.
No military obligation for male candidates.
Main Responsibilities
Providing installation, configuration, and technical support for the company's digital health products.
Integrating products with hospitals' technical infrastructure (network connections, low-current systems, cabling, etc.).
Coordinating with software teams to execute system updates and testing processes.
Providing user training and supporting customers in the effective use of products.
Providing technical support to the sales team, ensuring high customer satisfaction during technical service processes.
Analyzing technical issues that may arise in the field and providing solutions.
Work closely with internal teams (Service, Sales) to ensure smooth business operations.
Monitor, analyze, and report on service activities.
Ensure full compliance with company policies, ethical standards, and local regulations in all business activities.
About Us
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
